groups.defect: The `queued` dataclass default `timezone.now()` runs only once, at import time, so every AssignmentSource shares the same stale timestamp; it should use `field(default_factory=timezone.now)`.
`to_dict()` puts a raw datetime (`queued`) into the Celery task kwargs, so the JSON serializer fails when the task is enqueued, or `from_dict` gets the value back as a string.
